history_policy: one snapshot on public main; local development history and originals retained, not merged or pushed
excluded_categories: browser traces and cloud desktop captures
known_limits: Public source does not include private runtime data, credentials or full historical evidence.
Historical test outcomes retain their original dates; no alpha or deployment claim is made by GitHub publication.
Historical local commit IDs are provenance and need not resolve on GitHub.

verification.method: all product/test/config bytes and executable modes compared to source HEAD; selected evidence independently reviewed
